categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including parcel numbers, owner names, land extents, and property details. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses entirely on land registration and title settlement processes, making it a clear example of Land Gazettes (Type 4).
